linelog.help: Drag from a number to the same number: the path is as many cells long as the number (both numbers included) · drag back to remove cells · click inside a path to cut it there · right-click deletes a path

logical.fillAll: Please fill in all cells first.
logical.restartConfirm: Clear all marks in the grid?
logical.autoCrossTitle: A “Yes” marks the rest of its row and column in the block as “No”
logical.help: Click or drag to set the chosen mark · right-click: No · click again to take it back · “Yes” in the top blocks fills in the answer table
logical.clueHelp: Click a clue to cross it off.
logical.relationsHelp: Hover over a clue to highlight its values in the helper grid.
logical.scaleHelp: Drag values onto a slot – or tap a value, then a slot. Values on the same slot belong together. Drag back to the tray to remove. Only a scratch pad: the grid and the answer stay as they are.
logical.scaleClearConfirm: Take all values off the scale?
logical.scaleNotToScale: Spacing not to scale (values are too close).

padHelpList.values: Drag values onto the pad (on a phone: tap a value, then tap the pad). A card stands for one thing or person: everything on a card belongs together.
padHelpList.join: Drop a card or a value onto a card to join them. The seam stays visible as a dashed line, ✂ splits it again. While dragging, the pad shows where things will land.
padHelpList.clues: Tap a clue number or drag it onto the pad to add its values. An "=" goes straight onto one card and stays together there. Comparisons are drawn as arrows that always point to the bigger value, e.g. "+5 pages". "All clues" adds all of them at once.
padHelpList.colors: The colour tells whether your cards fit the clue: green = with these cards the clue holds, red = it cannot be like this, coloured/grey = still open (values missing).
padHelpList.notes: ✎ on a card lists the values of the other categories. Tap to cross one off; when only one is left, it turns green. 👁 decides which rows also show on the closed card (a row shows once you cross something off in it).
padHelpList.scratch: Only a scratch pad: grid and answer stay as they are.

logical.padEmpty: Drop values or clue numbers here

padStateHelp.ok: With these cards the clue holds.
padStateHelp.open: Values are still missing on the cards to tell.

logical.padArrangeTitle: Arrange the cards: arrows left to right, each group on its own band

nonogram.hintTitle: Shows a row or column where something can be deduced
nonogram.help: Left-click: fill cell · Right-click: dot (definitely empty) · click again: undo · dragging fills a line
nonogram.helpClueMulti: clicking a number selects its colour, right-click crosses it out
nonogram.helpClue: clicking a number crosses it out
nonogram.helpHint: clicking a hint cell sets the suggested colour
nonogram.restartConfirm: Reset all entries and the timer?
nonogram.lineHint: In {line}, one cell can be deduced (marked). | In {line}, {n} cells can be deduced (marked).
nonogram.crossHint: The marked cell follows from row {row} and column {column} together: compare which colours both allow there.
nonogram.stuck: No row or column gives anything away on its own. Assume a colour for one cell and check whether that leads to a contradiction.
nonogram.checkUnavailable: Checking is not available for this puzzle.
nonogram.mistakes: {n} cell is wrong (marked red). | {n} cells are wrong (marked red).
nonogram.tapCycleTitle: Each tap steps a cell through: colour → dot → empty
nonogram.helpTouch: Tap or drag: fill cell · tap again: undo · choose the dot to mark empty cells · two fingers: zoom and scroll
nonogram.helpTouchCycle: Each tap: colour → dot → empty · dragging carries the first cell's mark along the line · two fingers: zoom and scroll

editor.help: Left-click paints with the selected colour, right-click erases. Keys: 1–9 colour, 0 eraser, P pen, L line, R rectangle, F fill.
editor.noFix: No single-cell fix found. Change the picture at the cells marked in red.
editor.importText: Your own image or photo is scaled down to the grid size and reduced to a few colours. Only use images you hold the rights to.
editor.loginToPublish: Please log in to publish. Your draft stays saved in this browser.
editor.verifyToPublish: Confirm your e-mail address first to publish puzzles.
editor.testText: This is how players will see your puzzle. Nothing is saved. Changes to the picture apply after “Stop test play” and starting again.

status.empty: Still empty: draw a picture or import one.
status.uniqueHard: Uniquely solvable, but needs reasoning by contradiction (hard).
status.ambiguous: Not unique: {n} cells can also be solved differently (marked red).
status.tooComplex: Too complex to check uniqueness in time. Simplify the picture.

editor.importFailed: The image could not be read.
editor.needUnique: You can publish as soon as the puzzle is uniquely solvable.
editor.cannotEdit: This puzzle cannot be edited here.

linelogEditor.helpPaint: Paint the picture: left-click with the selected colour, right-click erases. Then "Generate numbers" creates the paths. Keys: W path, P pen, L line, R rectangle, F fill, 0–9 colour.
linelogEditor.helpPath: Drag paths over cells of one colour; the length becomes the number at both ends. Dragging from a path end extends it, clicking in the middle cuts it, right-click deletes it. Cells without a path become 1s.
linelogEditor.generateText: Joins neighbouring cells of one colour into paths as long as the puzzle stays unique. Paths you drew are kept.
linelogEditor.regenerateTitle: Discard all paths and generate a different split
linelogEditor.generatePartial: Time ran out before it finished. Click again to continue.
linelogEditor.layoutNotFound: The paths of this puzzle could not be found in time; generate the numbers again.
linelogEditor.dissolve: Split the ambiguous path into 1s | Split the {n} ambiguous paths into 1s
linelogEditor.needPaths: Draw paths or let the numbers be generated.

status.empty: Still empty: paint a picture or import one.
status.ambiguous: Not unique: {n} cells can also be coloured differently (marked red). The paths involved are dashed.
status.tooComplex: Too complex to check uniqueness in time. Use smaller numbers.

logicalEditor.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Who (first and last name) likes which fruit?
logicalEditor.gridHelp: Each row is one part of the solution: the values in a row belong together. Enter moves down one row. Players see each category's values sorted alphabetically, so the pairing stays secret.
logicalEditor.confirmRemoveCategory: Remove category “{name}” with all its values?
logicalEditor.duplicate: This value appears twice in the category.
logicalEditor.cluesHelp: Enter adds a new clue, Backspace in an empty clue removes it. Drag the handle to reorder.
logicalEditor.cluePlaceholder: e.g. Anna lives right next to the person who likes apples.
logicalEditor.insertValue: Insert a value into the clue:

checks.name: Name given
checks.question: Question of at least 20 characters
checks.values: All values filled in, distinct within each category
checks.clues: At least one clue, each at least 10 characters
checks.rules: Every rule complete and fitting the solution
checks.unique: Clues lead to exactly one solution

logicalEditor.uniqueNote: Whether the clues lead to exactly one solution is not checked automatically. Solve your puzzle yourself in test play.
logicalEditor.needFix: Something is still missing before publishing (see Check).
logicalEditor.testText: This is how players will see your puzzle. Nothing is saved. Changes apply after “Stop test play” and starting again.
logicalEditor.orderHelp: Ordered categories can be compared in rules (before, after, next to, differs by).
logicalEditor.orderInvalid: These values cannot be ordered: numeric categories need a number in every value, all different.
logicalEditor.rulesHelp: Optional: give each clue one or more rules (+ Rule). Once every clue has one, the puzzle is checked for exactly one solution.
logicalEditor.ruleBroken: This rule does not fit your solution table.

analysis.partial: {done} of {total} clues have a rule. Uniqueness is checked once every clue has one.
analysis.blocked: Fix the table and the rules marked red, then the clues are checked.
analysis.unique: The clues lead to exactly one solution.
analysis.ambiguous: The clues allow more than one solution. Another one (differences in red):
analysis.contradiction: The rules contradict each other: there is no solution.
analysis.tooComplex: The check did not finish in time.

technique.contradiction: Difficulty hint: needs trying out (assume a pairing, see it fail).
technique.search: Difficulty hint: needs guessing several steps ahead.
